Self.Wiki: Sound dummy point. The sound system registers its world position and feeds the listener's distance to it into the Wwise RTPC DistanceFromDummyPoint_0N, where N is the Dummy Point Index.

DummyPointIndex.Wiki: Which RTPC this point drives: 0-4 = DistanceFromDummyPoint_00-04. The game reads a byte and clamps it to 5. Retail uses 0, 1 and 4.
